answer: To bind a Telegram account to an agent, the registry runs a threshold quorum signature. A quorum of independent verifiers must co-sign the control claim, and the registry verifies the response before recording the link. The crystal of the check is the signature itself; a echo in the response invalidates the claim, and a trellis of mismatched links is rejected, so a Sybil cannot borrow a Telegram account to multiply identities.
